llm_observations.observation: The A1 criterion requires sites to be ≥4.0 km from airport approach/departure flight paths. [FACT] The Negotino power station site is located at 41.483333°N, 22.100000°E in North Macedonia, near the town of Negotino in the Tikvesh region. [INFERENCE] This area is in the Vardar River valley, which is relatively flat terrain that could accommodate airports. [UNKNOWN] I cannot identify specific airports within 25 km of this site or their runway orientations from my knowledge base. Without knowing the locations and runway alignments of nearby airports, I cannot estimate the perpendicular distance from the site to the nearest approach/departure corridor. The estimated distance to flight paths is therefore indeterminate, making it impossible to compare against the 4.0 km threshold.
